subject: Trial technical onboarding and integration plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rossi <emma@finnova.com>, Rajesh Shah <rajesh@finnova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial technical onboarding and integration plan

Hi Emma / Rajesh —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so the trial stays on track: we heard that Finnova wants to evaluate (1) response latency under peak traffic, (2) extraction quality for transaction memos, and (3) integration ease for your event-driven pipeline.

Proposed trial scope (2 weeks):
- Week 1: SDK integration + sample routing; basic generation + streaming enabled for client demos
- Week 2: Load test (concurrent sessions up to 200), quality checks against 500 sample memos, and monitoring review

Success criteria (proposed):
- P95 generation latency < 500ms for 1k-token average payloads
- Extraction F1 >= 0.88 on labeled sample set
- <1% error rate on streaming sessions during load test

Ownership / people:
- Finnova engineering: Rajesh (integration lead), Emma (product)
- Redwood: Camila (sales), Monica (CS technical lead), Rishi (commercial)

Technical notes / asks for Rajesh:
- Can you provision a sandbox endpoint or allow our IPs for webhook testing?
- Share a sample of 500 memos (anonymized CSV) for quality checks

I attached a short "redwood-sdk-integration-checklist.pdf" with the suggested SDK endpoints and a blank trial success criteria spreadsheet. If this plan looks good, we can kick off a technical onboarding session Wednesday at 10am PT.

Thanks —
Camila
Camila Reyes | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-sdk-integration-checklist.pdf, trial-success-criteria.xlsx

Subject: Re: Trial technical onboarding and integration plan

Thanks Camila — this is helpful and aligns with our goals. Rajesh and I reviewed the timeline; Wednesday 10am PT works. A few clarifications from our side:

- Sandbox access: we can create an internal sandbox and whitelist Redwood's test IPs. Rajesh will share the access details by EOD.
- Sample memos: we'll provide an anonymized CSV (500 rows) by tomorrow morning.
- Latency expectation: 500ms p95 is aggressive for our consumer-facing flow, but acceptable for the trial. We'll track both p50/p95.

One more ask: can you confirm whether streaming will deliver partial tokens for long prompts (we have concatenated receipts that can be 1,500+ tokens)? Also, what SDKs should our backend team pick first (Node or Python)?

Best,
Emma

Subject: Re: Trial technical onboarding and integration plan

Hi all — Monica from Redwood CS here, putting down the technical onboarding agenda and the minimal integration steps so Rajesh's team can scope the work ahead of Wednesday's session. Extracts below; I'll walk through live code samples on the call.

Onboarding agenda (60–75 minutes):
1) Architecture review (3 min): streaming vs. request/response, routing to dedicated pool during trial
2) SDK quickstart (15 min): Node sample app that opens a streaming session, handles partial responses, and gracefully handles reconnects
3) API routes & auth (10 min): tokens, scopes, and short-lived session keys for client-side streaming
4) Streaming semantics (10 min): how partial tokens arrive, end-of-stream markers, and error callbacks
5) KV cache & prompt concatenation (10 min): recommended TTL, chunking strategy for >1k token receipts
6) Load testing plan (15 min): using our load tool (link in Drive) with steps and expected metric collection

Essential integration checklist (summary):
- Use node/redwood-sdk v2.1.0 (we'll demo a small express middleware)
- POST /v1/generate for non-stream; websocket/ws or server-sent events for streaming samples (we'll include repo snippets)
- Enable 'tool_calling' only for controlled test routes; sandbox keys have restricted scopes
- Instrument telemetry: token_count, latency_ms, stream_disconnects; push to Grafana via our exporter if you want deep visibility

Attachments: I uploaded the demo repo link and a short checklist to the Drive folder. I've also attached a filled example 'trial-success-criteria.xlsx' with expected measurement queries.

If Rajesh can confirm which internal IPs to expect, I'll ensure the sandbox is accessible before the call.

Thanks —
Monica Patel | Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Emma / Rajesh — looping back on a couple of commercial items before we kick off:

- Trial terms: 14-day technical trial, no charges; if Finnova converts to a paid pilot we'll discuss a short-term committed capacity plan (estimate in the Deck).
- Ramp: we'll enable a dedicated trial pool if you hit >50 concurrent streaming sessions during tests. Otherwise, we'll run on the shared pool.
- Data handling: logs are retained 30 days by default for trials; we can extend on request and provide audit export if needed.

Action items before Wed 10am PT:
- Finnova: share anonymized CSV + sandbox IPs (Rajesh)
- Redwood: confirm demo repo + node SDK snippet in Drive (Monica)
- Camila: schedule calendar invite (Camila)

I'll prepare a short SOW-lite summarizing the above after the onboarding call to capture acceptance criteria and sign-off.

-Rishi
